Review exa.ai?

Reviewers are uniformly positive, though the feedback comes almost entirely from founders using Exa in their own products rather than end users. They consistently praise semantic search that finds relevant results instead of keyword noise, along with fast APIs, simple integration, and dependable real-time web retrieval for AI agents. Founders of Pancake, Slashy, and Lightfield cite concrete uses like people search, research, email prep, and CRM enrichment. No meaningful negatives appear in the reviews provided.

Most Informative

We use Exa to give Hyper's AI agent the ability to search the web mid-conversation. When a user asks something beyond their own meeting history, Exa handles the retrieval. We looked at Tavily and Brave Search API but Exa's results felt more semantically relevant out of the box, which matters when an agent is trying to answer a nuanced question in real time. Google Search API was too expensive for us. It felt dead simple to integrate too.
